decls.name: toyCarrier
decls.head: def toyCarrier : Set ℂ := {rhoE, Zeta23.reflect rhoE}

decls.name: toy_strip
decls.head: theorem toy_strip : ∀ ρ ∈ toyCarrier, 0 ≤ ρ.re ∧ ρ.re ≤ 1 := by

decls.name: toy_reflect_mem
decls.head: theorem toy_reflect_mem : ∀ ρ ∈ toyCarrier, Zeta23.reflect ρ ∈ toyCarrier := by

decls.name: toyRhs
decls.head: def toyRhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ := fun k => ∑' ρ : toyZ.carrier, (toyZ.mult ρ : ℂ) * Zeta23.paperFT k (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ)

decls.name: epstein_hypotheses_satisfiable
decls.head:
theorem epstein_hypotheses_satisfiable :
    ∃ (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (rhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ), EpsteinPremises Z rhs ∧ rhoE ∈ Z.carrier :=

decls.name: emptyRhs
decls.head: def emptyRhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ := fun k => ∑' ρ : emptyZ.carrier, (emptyZ.mult ρ : ℂ) * Zeta23.paperFT k (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ)

decls.name: membership_load_bearing
decls.head:
theorem membership_load_bearing :
    ∃ (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (rhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ) (hP : EpsteinPremises Z rhs), h2_sign_cfg (epsteinConfig Z rhs hP) :=
